unavailable.title: This identity link is unavailable
unavailable.body: The link is invalid, expired, already used, or belongs to another Paperclip organization.

linked.title: Identity linked
linked.body: Future messages from {{externalLabel}} use your current Paperclip permissions in {{companyName}}.

title: Link your external identity
confirmHint: Confirm only if this is your {{provider}} identity. Paperclip will check your current organization membership on every action.
confirmError: This link could not be confirmed. It may have expired or been revoked.

access.membershipRequired: You need membership in {{companyName}} before linking this account.
access.requested: Access requested. An admin can approve it in Paperclip. After approval, return here to confirm; if this link expires, send the connect command in Slack again.
access.error: Couldn't request access. The link may have expired. Send the connect command again and retry.
